ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Macro-level distribution is predominantly low-intensity (black) with approximately 10-15% high-intensity (white) pixel coverage in the form of scarring.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-contrast white pixel clusters and linear streaks distributed across both lobes; higher spatial density of linear marks on the interior right lobe.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Calculated central V-shaped notch with an approximate angle of 145 degrees; notch depth is approximately 5% of total vertical fluke height.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular pixel peaks and valleys along the trailing boundary, increasing in amplitude and irregularity toward the distal tips.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Mathematical concave curvature originating from the median notch and sweeping upward to the fluke tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Numerous circular and semi-circular high-contrast white pixel clusters, ranging from 3 to 10 pixels in diameter, scattered across the ventral surface of both lobes.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Extensive network of multi-directional white linear pixel disruptions (rake marks) that break the black pigmentation across the visible field.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Distinct brownish-orange high-intensity pixel clusters located at the extreme distal tips of both the left and right lobes.
other_distinctive_markers: Dense series of parallel vertical white linear marks on the lower medial section of the right lobe near the notch.
